_meta.generator: hand-written from EPMSStagingDB (SQL Server), checked against the data
_meta.note: Only tables described here are indexed for retrieval; the other staging tables (CPT, FNP, FLD, HPA, VRA, VHC, MEA, MAT, WCT, WTY, WBS, DES, FHG, FGC, tblweighings ...) are not understood well enough to describe and are left out on purpose.

OPH.description: Harvest tickets (OPH = output per harvest): one row per harvester per harvest point (TPH) per day, with the number of ripe bunches (ZMASAK) and loose fruit (ZBRONDOLAN, text). The core harvest fact for every estate (WERKS 00EA/00EB/00EC/00P1/00P2), about 3 million rows from 2025-01. Holds bunch counts only, no weight: tonnage comes from FDN.
example_questions: How many ripe bunches were harvested per estate last month?
Top 10 blocks by ripe bunches in estate EC this year
Which harvesters harvested the most bunches yesterday?
Total harvest per day for the last 30 days in EB
Berapa janjang yang dipanen per divisi bulan lalu?

key_columns.WERKS: Estate / plant code: 00EA, 00EB, 00EC, 00P1, 00P2 (join EST.WERKS). Filter on this for an estate; ignore rows where it is NULL
key_columns.BUDAT: Harvest date (date type) - use for ALL time filters
key_columns.BLOCK: Block code (varchar, e.g. '027'); unique only within the estate. Join BLK on ESTNR = RIGHT(WERKS, 2) AND BLOCK
key_columns.OPH: OPH ticket id (varchar); also the key FDN.OPH points to
key_columns.ZBRONDOLAN: Loose fruit (brondolan) stored as TEXT; use TRY_CAST(ZBRONDOLAN AS decimal(18,2))

common_joins.on: BLK.ESTNR = RIGHT(OPH.WERKS, 2) AND BLK.BLOCK = OPH.BLOCK AND BLK.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
EMP.EMPNR = OPH.EMPNR AND OPH.BUDAT BETWEEN EMP.KDATB AND EMP.KDATE

FDN.description: Delivery notes (SPB, surat pengantar buah) that carry harvest tickets from the field to the mill, with the weighbridge weight of the truck trip (gross BRUTO, tare TARRA, net WB_QTY_TOTAL in kg). One row per OPH ticket on the trip, so the trip weight is repeated on every row of the same SPB: take it once per SPB. The source of all tonnage figures.
example_questions: How many tonnes were delivered to the mill per estate last month?
Total delivered weight per day in the last 14 days for estate EC
How many trips were delivered this week?
Berapa tonase TBS yang dikirim bulan ini per kebun?

key_columns.ESTNR: Estate code in this table: EA, EB, EC, P1, P2 (NOT the WERKS form)
key_columns.SPB: Delivery note / trip id (varchar). One trip = one SPB
key_columns.OPH: Harvest ticket id carried on this trip (join OPH.OPH)
key_columns.WB_QTY_TOTAL: Weighbridge net weight of the WHOLE trip in kg, repeated on every row of the SPB; 0 = not weighed yet. Use MAX(WB_QTY_TOTAL) per SPB, never SUM over rows

BLK.description: Block master: every planted block of every estate with its division, status (MATURE, IMMATURE, LC), area in hectares (BHA), planting and maintenance start (INITL / MAINT as yyyymm) and crop. One row per validity period, so filter KDATE = '9999-12-31' for the current state.
example_questions: How many hectares of mature area does each estate have?
List the blocks of division 3 in estate EC with their area
Berapa luas blok TM per divisi di EC?

key_columns.ESTNR: Estate code (EA, EB, EC, P1, P2)
key_columns.DIVNR: Division number (varchar) - join DIV with ESTNR
key_columns.BLOCK: Block code (varchar); unique only within the estate
key_columns.BSTATE: Block status: MATURE, IMMATURE, LC (land clearing)

common_joins.on: DIV.ESTNR = BLK.ESTNR AND DIV.DIVNR = BLK.DIVNR AND DIV.KDATE = '9999-12-31'

EST.description: Estate master: the five estates of the group (Estate A/B/C and plasma schemes Plasma 1/2) with the plant code WERKS used by every transaction table.
example_questions: Which estates are there?
Name of estate 00EC

key_columns.ESTNR: Estate code: EA, EB, EC, P1, P2
key_columns.WERKS: Plant code 00EA..00P2 used by OPH, GWO, OVT
key_columns.NAME1: Estate name: ESTATE A, ESTATE B, ESTATE C, PLASMA 1, PLASMA 2

DIV.description: Division master: the divisions (afdeling) of each estate, named 'Division 1', 'Division 2', ... Divisions are identified by estate + number.
example_questions: Ripe bunches per division in estate EC last month
How many divisions does each estate have?

key_columns.ESTNR: Estate code (EA, EB, EC, P1, P2)

EMP.description: Employee master with history: name, job (JBCDE: HARVESTERS, MANDOR PANEN, CHECKER, DRIVER, UPKEEP, ...), sex, employment status and division. One row per validity period of an employee (KDATB..KDATE); about 12 thousand distinct employees across all estates.
example_questions: How many harvesters does each estate have?
Headcount per job title in estate EB
Berapa jumlah karyawan wanita per kebun?

key_columns.EMPNR: Employee number (varchar, e.g. 00/00EC/0825/3180) - same code in OPH, ATD, GWO, OVT
key_columns.JBCDE: Job: HARVESTERS, MANDOR PANEN, CHECKER, DRIVER, OPERATOR, UPKEEP, MANDOR PERAWATAN, STAFF, ASISTEN MANAGER, ...
key_columns.STATS: Employment status code (KTB, KBT, KONTRAKB, KTH, ...)

common_joins.on: EMP.EMPNR = OPH.EMPNR AND OPH.BUDAT BETWEEN EMP.KDATB AND EMP.KDATE
EMP.EMPNR = ATD.EMPNR AND ATD.BUDAT BETWEEN EMP.KDATB AND EMP.KDATE

MEM.description: Employee-to-mandor assignment over time: which foreman (EMPNR_M) a worker (EMPNR) reported to, per validity period.
example_questions: Who is the mandor of employee X?
How many workers does each mandor have?

key_columns.PRFNR: Estate name as text ('ESTATE A' ... 'ESTATE PLASMA 2')

ATD.description: Daily attendance: one row per employee per day with the attendance code ATDCD (K worked, KS worked Saturday, M absent without leave, C leave, S1/S2 sick, P1-P4 permitted absence ...), the employee's mandor and the department. About 1.6 million rows.
example_questions: How many workers were absent without leave (mangkir) yesterday?
Attendance rate per estate last month
Berapa orang mangkir per kebun minggu ini?

key_columns.PRFNR: Estate NAME as text: 'ESTATE A', 'ESTATE B', 'ESTATE C', 'ESTATE PLASMA 1', 'ESTATE PLASMA 2'. ATD has no WERKS: group or filter attendance by estate with this
key_columns.ATDCD: Attendance code, described in ATC.CODE: K worked, KS worked Saturday, KT worked (no HK), KL paid Sunday, M absent, C leave, H1/H2 menstrual/maternity leave, S1/S2 sick, P1-P4 permission

common_joins.on: ATD.EMPNR = EMP.EMPNR AND ATD.BUDAT BETWEEN EMP.KDATB AND EMP.KDATE

ATC.description: Attendance code lookup: the meaning (Indonesian) of each ATDCD value, e.g. K = Kerja, M = Mangkir, C = Cuti.
example_questions: What does attendance code M mean?

key_columns.DESC: Meaning in Indonesian - a reserved word, write it as [DESC]

GWO.description: Daily work done (general work orders): one row per employee per activity per day with the activity (ACTVT_NO), block, quantity (MENGE in unit AMEIN), man-days (HKINP) and rate. Covers all non-harvest field work - manuring, spraying, weeding, pruning, upkeep, supervision - for every estate, about 860 thousand rows.
example_questions: How many man-days were spent per activity last month in estate EA?
Man-days per block for manuring this year
Total HKINP per estate by month

key_columns.PRFNR: Estate name as text ('ESTATE A' ... 'ESTATE PLASMA 2')
key_columns.BLOCK: Block code (may be empty for general work)
key_columns.AMEIN: Unit of MENGE (HA, P, KG, TON, BAG, ...)

common_joins.on: GWO.EMPNR = EMP.EMPNR AND GWO.BUDAT BETWEEN EMP.KDATB AND EMP.KDATE
BLK.ESTNR = RIGHT(GWO.WERKS, 2) AND BLK.BLOCK = GWO.BLOCK AND BLK.KDATE = '9999-12-31'

ACT.description: Activity master: number and name of each field activity (e.g. 'PUNGUT BRONDOLAN', 'PENGAWASAN PANEN (MANDOR)') with its default unit, used to describe the work in GWO.
example_questions: Which activities exist for manuring?
Man-days per activity name

key_columns.ACTVT_NAME: Activity name in Indonesian, uppercase - match with LIKE '%KEYWORD%'

OVT.description: Overtime: one row per employee per day with the overtime hours (NHOUR), start/end time, estate and block.
example_questions: Total overtime hours per estate last month
Who worked the most overtime this week?

common_joins.on: OVT.EMPNR = EMP.EMPNR AND OVT.BUDAT BETWEEN EMP.KDATB AND EMP.KDATE
